How to play

Build the best five-card hand from your two private cards and the five shared cards on the table.

  • Check — stay in for free when there’s no bet to match.
  • Call — match the current bet to keep playing.
  • Raise — increase the bet with the slider to pressure opponents.
  • Fold — give up the hand and lose nothing more.

Hands, best to worst: Royal flush · Straight flush · Four of a kind · Full house · Flush · Straight · Three of a kind · Two pair · Pair · High card.

Keys: F fold · C check/call · R raise · ←→ size · Enter next hand · L log · H help

Heads-up: the dealer posts the small blind, acts first before the flop and last after it.

Sit & Go: everyone starts with 1,500 chips, blinds rise every 6 hands, top 3 are paid into your bank. B rabbit hunt after a fold.
